hero.title: A trusted, public-facing home for DHRC growth and community visibility.
hero.lead: The DHRC Master Blueprint 3.0 is designed to communicate mission, services, and public commitment in a clear, respectful, trauma-informed way while keeping confidential survivor information protected and out of public systems.
commitments: No fake claims or sensitive data
hero.panelTitle: Built for launch, clarity, and future growth.

mission.heading: A mission-driven website foundation for DHRC.
mission.body: This site helps DHRC present its organisational purpose, services, and values with confidence and professionalism. It gives the public a clear sense of what the organisation stands for while making it easy to keep sensitive operational information separate from public-facing communications.
mission.bodyTwo: The design is intentionally simple, flexible, and low-cost to maintain, making it suitable for a launch that can grow into a stronger digital presence over time without requiring a complicated technical stack in the first phase.

pillars.heading: Service areas and public information pillars

items.title: Prevention and awareness
items.description: Respectful public messaging that builds understanding and trust around DHRC’s mission and values.

items.title: Case support pathways
items.description: Clear signposting to support and referral processes while keeping confidential care channels protected.

items.title: Community engagement
items.description: A public-facing platform for supporters, partners, and volunteers to understand the organisation’s goals.

items.title: Capacity building
items.description: A foundation that can support future grant applications, operational growth, and website evolution.

steps.title: Define the public message
steps.text: Focus your website on verified mission, values, and public service information only. Avoid sharing private survivor information or unverified claims.

steps.title: Build a resilient structure
steps.text: Create reusable content blocks, clean navigation, and clear writing so the team can maintain the site quickly and consistently.

steps.title: Prepare for launch
steps.text: Use a free static hosting workflow, connect the domain later, and keep advanced secure systems behind separate protected infrastructure.

items.title: Public information hub
items.description: A central, easy-to-read place for DHRC mission, values, and public engagement details.

items.title: Referral guidance
items.description: A clear, privacy-aware pathway for people to find help and contact the organisation appropriately.

items.title: Website governance
items.description: Simple, maintainable content structure so updates are easy without technical complexity.

items.title: Future expansion
items.description: A foundation that can later support secure systems, CMS options, and improved member or partner portals.

items.question: Is this site meant for public launch only?
items.answer: Yes. This is intentionally the public-facing foundation, not the secure internal case-management layer.

items.question: Can this be hosted for free?
items.answer: Yes. The structure is designed for static deployment on free-tier hosting such as Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or similar providers.

items.question: What should be kept out of public content?
items.answer: No confidential survivor details, identifying records, unverified claims, sensitive case files, or operational information that should remain protected.
